does_experience_compound.reading: a change smaller than 0.25 bits cannot be told apart from which pages happened to be in which half

is_the_cost_page_shaped.reading: the cost is log2 of the candidates that still fit, so a heavy right tail is dense pages rather than a weak learner

the_answer: NO, at this size. Across the 78 tasks that produced a program, the cost of an unseen step moves from 5.49 to 5.39 bits -- a change of -0.10 over the whole run, which is flat within the threshold that this measurement can resolve. The vocabulary keeps growing (96 descriptions, 57% of them arriving in the second half), and the language is already minimal: 90% of the bill sits in three attributes that are each needed to name an element, so removing one removes the ability to say what a step targets. 63% of real steps face more than 30 candidate descriptions, so the price is set by how dense a page is, not by what the learner has already seen.
what_this_refuses_to_claim: that one experience is useless -- it pays about one bit, permanently, and that is real
that the 5 bits are irreducible in principle -- a smaller language would lower them; measured here, the language is already small and the price is spread over attributes that are each necessary
that a better learner would fix it -- the cost is log2 of what the page does not distinguish, which no learner can lower by seeing more pages
that this generalises beyond MiniWoB-shaped pages -- it is one recorded run
the_lever_that_remains: the bill is log2 of the descriptions that still fit, so it falls when an OBSERVATION REMOVES candidates -- an acting question, not a learning one. Looking before choosing, and pages that distinguish their elements, lower the price in a way no amount of experience can.
why_this_round_exists: Rounds 9-12 built a machine that can produce a missing kind and judge it, and by rounds 11-12 it could read 98.2% of a real system. Before building round 13 on the same pattern I tested the STRATEGY those rounds assume: that one demonstration per environment, plus a published guide, totals computer use. The tree already held the numbers to answer it, so no new episode was needed.

what_was_already_in_the_project.what_one_experience_buys_v1: one experience pays about 1 bit, a step costs 5.43, 99.4% of steps need more than one bit; reuse 1.55x; vocabulary does not saturate; names "a smaller description language" as the remaining lever
what_was_already_in_the_project.MINIWOB_ONE_SUCCESS_GENERALISATION_20261: the recorded run: 130 tasks, 78 with programs, 478 steps with a measured descriptions_left
what_was_already_in_the_project.the_honest_prior: the strategy had already been measured as pointing the wrong way, for element identification

what_is_new: three measurements the tree did not have: (1) whether the cost of an UNSEEN step falls across the run, walked in order and weighted by steps; (2) where the bill sits by attribute, to test the smaller-language lever; (3) whether the cost distribution is page-shaped, which decides if any learner could lower it

does_experience_compound.reading: a change smaller than 0.25 bits cannot be told apart from which pages happened to be in which half

honest_limits: one recorded run; MiniWoB-shaped pages only
the 0.25-bit threshold is a resolution statement, not a law
the recorded receipt holds first_success programs, so learned skills beyond the first success are not in this count
the smaller-language lever is measured as spent HERE, at this size; a different description language is not excluded
no new episode was run and no benchmark task; this is a measurement over a recorded receipt
authority NONE, sandbox only, independent verification OPEN
verdict_on_the_strategy: RETRACTED AS A TOTAL ANSWER. Learn each environment once and that totals computer use is FALSE for the measured cost of identifying a step, because the price is set by page density and does not fall with experience. What survives is narrower and still worth having: each experience permanently removes about one bit, and the machine now has a mechanism (rounds 9-12) that reads and judges the environment that bit is about.
